pattern: AgentTeam uses project-local JSONL memory for durable learnings and session restore state
context: Initialized from agent-memory-tools reference with tools, bin wrappers, and memory data files.

pattern: AgentTeam should route multi-model work by role, uncertainty, risk, and budget: cheap scouts first, Codex for repo-grounded implementation, Claude for planning/review judgment, premium models only for high-risk escalation
context: User listed available tools: Claude opus/sonnet, Codex GPT-5.4/5.5, Antigravity Gemini Flash, pi-agent DeepSeek/Kimi.

pattern: Phase 2 prototype lives under prototype/ (Vite + React 18 + TS), mock state in App.tsx useState, Operator Console dark/dense styling driven by single styles.css with CSS vars
Prototype is desktop-first: .app has min-width 1100px and #root scrolls horizontally on narrow viewports instead of collapsing the rail or crushing board columns

Canonical prototype lives at root src/ (lucide UI + shared domain model + delegation tracker). The separate prototype/ dir was a redundant parallel build and was removed; do not reintroduce a second prototype
MVP state store is SQLite at .agentteam/state.db; schema in docs/data-schema.md maps domain.ts 1:1, enums as TEXT+CHECK, arrays as JSON TEXT, everything scoped by run_id
MVP is full-stack: Express API (server/) + better-sqlite3 at .agentteam/state.db + React. Frontend talks to backend via src/api.ts; run with npm run dev:all (API :4000, web :5173, vite proxies /api)

Agent execution is a simulated adapter in server/adapter.ts: runTask drives a task ready->running->review writing delegated_run + activity events + review gate + inbox items in one transaction. Real codex/claude CLI adapter implements the same runTask contract
Every delegated AgentTeam run must maintain observable artifacts: task, plan, heartbeat, progress, decisions, blockers, evidence, summary, and result; task status and run status are separate
context: User requested a standard development protocol so different agents know what to update while doing their assigned work.

pattern: Delegated agents must sync memory at handoff: retrieve memory before work, record memory used, add only durable learnings, save context for resumable state, and consider brain sync after reusable high-confidence lessons
context: User emphasized timely memory sync for efficient multi-agent communication.

pattern: Write-capable delegated agents must develop in isolated task worktrees, commit only stable handoff states after validation/artifact updates, and leave merges into main to the human/integration agent
context: User requested standards for worktree development, commit timing, and additional multi-agent engineering norms.

pattern: Before starting any phase or non-trivial task, run 'bin/memory apply --query <keywords>' first, and 'bin/context restore' when resuming after an interruption. Write-side (memory add / context save) is not enough; the read-side retrieval is what prevents rework (e.g. duplicate prototype/ dir in Phase 4).
context: AGENTS.md requires memory retrieval before work; this was skipped in Phase 4/5.

pattern: Phase 6 real adapter foundation is merged: existing run endpoints stay simulated by default; explicit provider body claude/codex/pi-agent routes to guarded real adapter, and real execution requires AGENTTEAM_REAL_ADAPTER_ENABLED=1
context: Formal development started by merging pi-agent scout and Codex implementation branches.

pattern: pi-agent adapter must invoke local CLI as pi -p with provider-qualified model names such as moonshotai-cn/kimi-k2.6 or deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash; short alias kimi-2.6 failed locally
context: pi-agent scout branch validated available model names and command templates.

pattern: Do not substitute ~/.claude/settings-deepseek.json for original Anthropic Claude Code review/delegation. Original Claude Code first-party path is blocked by Bun/Shadowrocket certificate behavior until fixed; keep Claude review tasks blocked rather than routing them through DeepSeek-backed settings.
context: User explicitly requested original Claude Code only. DeepSeek profile was useful only as a diagnostic proof that the CLI can run against third-party endpoints, not as an acceptable Claude replacement.

pattern: Phase 7 delegated batch is tracked in docs/phase-7-task-assignments.md: Codex owns adapter tests and artifact import helpers, pi-agent owns CLI output scout and dry-run runbook, and original Claude Code safety review remains blocked until the first-party TLS/proxy issue is fixed
context: User asked to return to project development and start writing docs plus task assignments after rejecting DeepSeek-backed Claude settings as a Claude substitute.

pattern: Agent provider registry is server/agentRegistry.ts: single source of truth mapping each TUI to its best model (claude->opus, codex->gpt-5-codex, antigravity->gemini-2.5-pro, pi-agent->deepseek/kimi/local) plus role->provider routing. Antigravity provider runs via the installed 'gemini' CLI binary, not an 'antigravity' binary.
Frontend cannot import server/ types; PROVIDER_UI in src/App.tsx mirrors server/agentRegistry.ts models. Keep them in sync when adding providers/models.

Claude provider must invoke original Claude Code through the claude-official command, not claude and not ~/.claude/settings-deepseek.json; keep review/delegation blocked if claude-official is unavailable.
context: User explicitly corrected the Claude command after rejecting DeepSeek-backed Claude settings.

pattern: claude-official is available at /Users/luffy/.local/bin/claude-official and supports non-interactive Claude Code calls with -p; use it for original Claude review/delegation tasks.
context: Verified with claude-official --version returning 2.1.168 and claude-official -p 'Return exactly: ok' returning ok.

pattern: Delegated coding sessions must use four control rules: write validation before implementation for behavior changes, require plan review before edits over 100 lines, constrain exact write scope, and include a clear proposed commit message at handoff.
context: User stated these as development principles to ensure agents prove understanding instead of producing polished-looking code.

pattern: Real adapter now imports actual diffs: realAdapter creates a git worktree (server/worktree.ts ensureWorktree) only when guard enabled and not dry-run, executes the CLI there, then collectChangedFiles stages and reads git diff --cached --numstat to populate review gate changedFiles/diffSummary. File-backed artifacts written to .agentteam/runs/<drun-id>/ (server/artifacts.ts).

Multi-run bug fixed: planner agent ids must be unique per run (agent-<role>-<tag>); store.ts mutations route through ownerAgentId(runId, role) instead of hardcoded agent-<role> ids, else agents.id PRIMARY KEY collides on the 2nd run in one DB.

Tests run via 'npm test' (tsx server/_tests/run.ts): plain assertion script, sets AGENTTEAM_DB to a temp file + guard off before dynamic-importing modules. Covers diff collection, simulated default, guard-off blocked, dry-run blocked, bad provider.
